q: Margulis superrigidity theorem (1974), which inspired the Zimmer program, states that any homomorphism from a higher-rank lattice Γ to GL(n,ℝ):
opts: Extends to a representation of the ambient Lie group
Has image in a compact group
exp: Margulis superrigidity: any homomorphism Γ → GL(n,ℝ) from a lattice in a higher-rank semisimple group either has precompact image or extends (up to finite index) to an algebraic representation of the Lie group. It implies arithmeticity of lattices.
